classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Design at most two compact protein binders against the provided target structure, score each with ipSAE interface confidence, and return a deterministically ranked shortlist.
assumptions: Target chain is A; boltzgen will place the generated binder on chain B in the refolded complex.
Binder length defaults to 60 residues; no hotspot residues were supplied so boltzgen will use its auto-detected interface.
Two parallel boltzgen shards (seed 1 and seed 2) each produce one design through the full diffusion+inverse-fold+refold+filter pipeline (design_only=false).
num_diffusion_steps is reduced to 200 for a fast first-pass; quality is slightly lower than the 500-step default but sufficient for triage.
ipSAE cutoff and dist_cutoff are left at their defaults (10.0 Å) for an unbiased first-pass interface score.
rank_designs top_k=2 covers the entire candidate set; no further filtering is applied at this stage.
submit_candidate is excluded from this plan per workflow policy; submission is a post-round decision made after inspecting actual ranked outputs.
missing_inputs: target_pdb — path to the target .pdb or .cif file was not included in the request; set params.target_pdb to a valid local path before executing the workflow.
